title: Limit nonterminal launcher reply handling to focused mode and cover live-mode exclusion
outcome: Nonterminal launcher forwarding and keep-open behavior follow the intended focused-only boundary, with an explicit live-mode control.
acceptance: The recorder forwarding predicate and command keep-open guard apply only to the agreed focused launcher mode, preserving full and live behavior unless a separately approved contract explicitly includes them.
A live launcher NotFinished control checks its observation/closure behavior and proves no native verification credit is created.
